about_the_game:
Eight time periods from across human history collide in a competitive bid to stop the end of the world. Go from fighting monsters to solving a murder, dating sim to escape game. Experience seven vastly different routes in a bid to solve the mystery as to why you've all been brought together.

AGERASIA is a visual novel style, comedic narrative-driven game which centres around eight unique participants, each one hailing from a different point in human history. You will follow Camden Connolly, born and raised in the Modern Era, they find themselves in an unfamiliar situation alongside seven other colourful characters, each from a different Era of human history - going as far back as Prehistory, all the way up to the Distant Future. Finding themselves at the whims of a curious floating blobfish known as Rantan, the eight are tasked with using time travelling lanterns to compete against each other in a bid to restore a supposed reality-bending world event.

  • Unique route-specific playstyles                                                                                                                                      Seven routes each with vastly different locales, characters, and plots, complete with differing gameplay all within the confines of a visual novel. You will go from choosing how you approach an RPG-style battle, to identifying the evidence and inconsistencies of a murder, to choosing your dialogue in dating sim segments, and much more.

  • Comedically-driven narrative                                                                                                                                           A story that only takes itself seriously when it truly needs to, comedically-driven with characters fuelled by dry wit and sarcasm. A light hearted yet incredibly expansive and engaging story.

  • Choose your own adventure                                                                                                                                            Complete the main seven routes in any order you like, make decisions to see unique dialogue and discover over 20 endings on your way to solving the mystery behind why everyone was brought together.

  • Vast cast of colourful characters                                                                                                                                     Meet a washed out rockstar from the 80s, an overworked Victorian stagehand, the daughter of a high priestess gladiator, a frog-like imp who co-owns the last bar left on Earth, and... that's just some of the main cast. You'll encounter a plethora of unique and downright exotic characters throughout your travels.

Unravel the truth behind this time travel misadventure as you jump across human history in AGERASIA.
